scope: Local bounded serialization and compression search; no live or network-overhead claim.

serializer.note: The 392 B final size is from the full 5,988-setting stock build grid, not the serializer’s reduced setting subset.

limitations: Finite search, not a global minimum.
Pinned encoder output was reproduced with fresh compilations on one macOS host; cross-platform generation reproducibility was not established.
The saved standard stream is selected only when it exactly decodes to current HTML and is no larger than the stock result.
Compared with the separately tested 393/540/528 B candidate, this saves one Brotli byte and costs two bytes in each fallback.
